# FPS Counter 3.1 required notices and redistribution

Exact source commit: dc2884a3778a4785e1ffa8e3b0b0940f3dde786c, tag v3.1. Preserve the original source/assembly notices; the assembly copyright string is “Copyright ©  2018” with no named owner. Do not fill that blank with a guessed copyright holder.

The project license is Apache-2.0, preserved verbatim in Apache-2.0.txt. Give recipients the license, retain applicable copyright/patent/trademark/attribution notices, retain any upstream NOTICE that applies, and mark files modified by a future derivative. No dedicated NOTICE file was present in this exact tagged source tree or one-DLL runtime ZIP; this is a bounded archive finding, not a general statement about other versions. This review did not modify source or binaries.

**Additional incorporated code:** FPSCounter/Extensions/StringBuilderFormat.cs and StringBuilderNumerics.cs carry “Copyright (c) Gavin Pugh 2010” and explicitly select the zlib license. Preserve their original headers (Gavin-Pugh-Original-Source-Notices.txt) and zlib terms (Zlib-License-Reference.txt with ZLIB_REFERENCE.json provenance). These helpers are compiled into FPSCounter.dll; they are not covered merely by pointing at the root Apache license. Do not misrepresent their origin or authorship; altered source versions must be plainly marked and source notices must remain. The full untouched source snapshot also preserves these headers and upstream integration as distributed. No new modifications are claimed here.

Unmodified Apache/zlib redistribution does not generally require publishing all source, but this review preserves the exact complete official source for attribution/provenance and future inspection. If the maintainer offers source alongside future binaries, use this exact commit/archive and document actual later changes. The installer project's GPL does not replace the plugin/helper licenses.

Runtime dependencies are the existing BepInEx5 and Harmony compatibility stack (MIT notices retained separately) and the original game's Unity/.NET environment. Preserve all already-cleared framework/dependency notices in a future installer; the copies here are a dependency evidence record, not replacements for its full notice set. Do not bundle UnityEngine.dll, game assemblies or the reference-library NuGet packages. No configuration-menu installation is required or recommended by this review.

This clearance covers only the exact official v3.1 DLL hash recorded in CLEARANCE_STATUS.json. Other historical 3.1 variants, newer releases, modified binaries, new builds, extra dependencies and game assets are not silently approved.
